t: This is Brompton Square, a garden square in London's Brompton district, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Two people with connections to the square are worth a mention. Robin Hill, the 8th Marquess of Downshire, an Irish peer, was born here in 1929. Henry Luttrell, an English politician, wit and writer of society verse, died here in 1851. I don't have much more to say about the square itself, so enjoy the quiet of the gardens and the houses around them.
